templates.why_chosen: Three goal panels separated by dotted lines reuse the same bank/Client/Log icon trio, changing only which actor is tinted red as untrusted, a small-multiples pattern the ranking script flagged low confidence despite the clean fit.
templates.what_to_learn: Separate small-multiple goal panels with a plain dotted vertical line rather than a full frame, and keep the same three actor icons (bank, client, database) in every panel, changing only which one is coloured red to mark the untrusted party; label each panel's goal in words, not a letter, when the goal is the title.
